name: Bad Bunny (Benito Martínez Ocasio)
role: Artist — Puerto Rican rapper, singer, songwriter
quote: I feel free. I do what I want. I wear what I want. I say what I want. I live my life and I'm proud of it.

name: Noah Assad
role: CEO & Founder, Rimas Entertainment — Bad Bunny's manager since 2016
quote: Label revenue is 50% of his business, publishing is around 30%, touring is 15% to 18%, and sponsorships are 5%.

name: J Balvin
role: Colombian reggaetón superstar — collaborator on 'I Like It,' 'Oasis' EP, and 'Un Día'
quote: Bad Bunny changed the game for all of us. He proved the world will listen to Spanish.

name: Daddy Yankee
role: Puerto Rican reggaetón pioneer — marched alongside Bad Bunny in 2019 Puerto Rico protests
quote: Puerto Rico tiene que ser primero. (Puerto Rico has to come first.)

name: Jhay Cortez
role: Puerto Rican singer-songwriter — featured on global #1 'Dakiti'; frequent live collaborator
quote: 'Dakiti' was a whole new level for us. Eight weeks at #1 globally — I didn't think that was possible for us.

name: Rosalía
role: Spanish singer — featured on 'La Noche de Anoche' from El Último Tour del Mundo
quote: Benito is someone who is fearless. He does what he wants artistically and it's incredibly inspiring.

name: Cardi B
role: American rapper — featured on #1 Hot 100 'I Like It' (2018) and Super Bowl LX halftime show (2026)
quote: I Like It is one of my favorite songs I've ever been a part of. Bunny is just different.

name: Drake
role: Canadian rapper — featured on 'MIA' (#5 Hot 100, 2018), one of Bad Bunny's first major English crossover collabs
quote: Bad Bunny is one of the most talented artists I've ever worked with. Period.

name: Li Saumet (Bomba Estéreo)
role: Colombian artist — featured on 'Ojitos Lindos' from Un Verano Sin Ti, showcasing Bad Bunny's genre range
quote: Benito has such a clear idea of what he wants, and he is open to explore new ideas, without fears.

name: Tainy
role: Puerto Rican producer and artist — key collaborator and producer on multiple albums and singles
quote: We grew up together. Bad Bunny, me, we're all from the same place, from the same culture, and that's what you hear in every record.

name: Residente (René Pérez Joglar)
role: Puerto Rican artist and activist — collaborated on 2019 protest anthem 'Afilando los Cuchillos'; directing Bad Bunny in *Porto Rico* (epic Caribbean western, announced Feb 18, 2026), his feature directorial debut co-starring Viggo Mortensen, Edward Norton, and Javier Bardem
quote: When the people called, Bad Bunny came. That says everything about who he is. And now, I get to tell our history together — our real Puerto Rican history.

name: Karol G
role: Colombian reggaetón artist — guest at Super Bowl LX halftime show (Feb 2026); first Latina to headline Coachella (Apr 12, 2026), following Bad Bunny's landmark 2023 set
quote: To share the Super Bowl stage with Bad Bunny — that's something I'll tell my grandchildren about.

name: Lady Gaga
role: American pop superstar — surprise guest at Super Bowl LX halftime show (Feb 8, 2026), performing a Latin-fusion version of 'Die With a Smile'
quote: Being part of that Super Bowl moment — Bad Bunny's vision for that show was pure love for his culture. I was honored to be invited into it.

name: Ricky Martin
role: Puerto Rican pop icon — surprise guest at Super Bowl LX halftime show (Feb 8, 2026), performing 'LO QUE LE PASÓ A HAWAii'
quote: What Bad Bunny did at the Super Bowl was a gift to Puerto Rico and to every Latino who ever felt invisible in this country.

name: María Zardoya (The Marías)
role: Puerto Rican-American singer — featured on 'Otro Atardecer' from Un Verano Sin Ti (2022); Cultured magazine April 2026 profile credits Bad Bunny discovery as pivotal to their rise
quote: Bad Bunny showed the world all the colors of Latin music. We never anticipated getting this big — it takes 10 years to become an overnight success.

name: Timothée Chalamet
role: American actor — co-starred with Bad Bunny in Adidas FIFA World Cup 2026 global campaign (May 2026); the trailer's 'I know about football, Benito' line became a viral moment
quote: What do I know about soccer? Nothing. I know about football, Benito. Football.

name: Janthony Oliveras
role: Creative director — Bad Bunny's longtime visual collaborator; co-designed the Zara x Bad Bunny 'BENITO ANTONIO' 150-piece collection (May 21, 2026) and the custom outfits for the Super Bowl LX halftime show and 2026 Met Gala
quote: Everything we do is rooted in Puerto Rican identity. The collection is a love letter to who Benito is — not the artist, but the person.

name: Myke Towers
role: Puerto Rican rapper and singer — made history at Madrid Night 1 (May 30, 2026) as the first artist ever to perform live alongside Bad Bunny, joining for 'Adivino' and a medley including 'Diosa,' 'Si Se Da,' 'Lala,' and 'La Falda' before 64,000 fans at Riyadh Air Metropolitano
quote: Benito called, I showed up. Two kids from Puerto Rico in front of 64,000 people in Madrid — that's our flag flying highest.

name: Luar La L
role: Dominican-American rapper — surprise guest at Madrid Night 2 (May 31, 2026), performing 'Teléfono Nuevo' from 'La Casita' platform at Riyadh Air Metropolitano before 64,000 fans
quote: Bad Bunny opened his stage to me in front of all of Madrid. That's love, that's cultura.

name: Young Miko
role: Puerto Rican LGBTQ+ rapper — surprise guest at Madrid Night 3 (June 2, 2026), climbing atop La Casita at Riyadh Air Metropolitano to perform their 2023 collaboration 'FINA' plus her own tracks 'Chulo Pt. 2,' 'WASSUP,' and 'BIAF<3' before 64,000 fans
quote: La Casita con Benito en Madrid — para siempre en mi corazón.

name: Jowell & Randy
role: Puerto Rican reggaetón duo — surprise guests at the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour finale (Brussels, July 22, 2026), closing out the 55-date global tour
quote: Closing out Bad Bunny's world tour in Brussels, with our people, with our music — that's history for reggaetón.

name: Rauw Alejandro
role: Puerto Rican singer — surprise reunion guest at the true tour-closing night (Hiram Bithorn Stadium, Aug 23, 2026), performing 'Party' and 'Qué Pasaría...' before the hometown crowd
quote: Closing this tour with Benito, in our own house — that's a full-circle moment for Puerto Rican music.

name: Víctor Manuelle
role: Puerto Rican salsa legend — surprise guest at the tour-closing night (Hiram Bithorn Stadium, Aug 23, 2026), performing 'Mala y peligrosa' with improvised verses
quote: Salsa and reggaetón are both Puerto Rico's heartbeat — sharing that stage with Benito on our closing night said it all.
